name: Class of '86: The Reunion
tagline: Big hair, bigger secrets, and a time capsule nobody wants opened.
era: The Class of '86 reunion, twenty years on
description: Twenty years on, the Class of '86 is back in the school gym: the prom queen, the quarterback, the science whiz and the class clown. The balloons are up, the DJ is spinning the '80s hits, and at ten o'clock the class will open its time capsule. But somebody would rather it stayed closed. A family-friendly mystery for all ages.
artStyle: 1980s neon synthwave, VHS grain, bold magenta and cyan

cocktails.name: Neon Prom Punch
cocktails.recipe: Lemonade, pineapple juice and a splash of blue raspberry syrup, over lots of ice.
cocktails.mocktail: It's already alcohol-free: add a scoop of lime sherbet to make it fizz.
